notes.title: The Input Update - LEAD - Rally V0.3
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Drivers and soon to be Legends![/h1]

Drop your wrenches and grab your steering wheels because [i][b]LEAD - Rally[/b][/i]'s latest patch, V0.3, is  rolling out!

[h2]So, what's new?[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Custom Controls:[/b] Your ride, your rules. The input system has been overhauled to put you in the driver's seat of customization. Now, you can map your key bindings to fit your racing style and gear up with [i][b]any controller[/b][/i] that gets your motor running – [b]yes, Steering Wheels included![/b]
[*][b]Bug Pit Stop:[/b] We've been under the hood, tightening bolts and polishing chrome. General bug fixes mean smoother rides, less jitters, and more fun.
[/list]

[h2]What remains the same?[/h2]

Your voice is still important. Every piece of feedback, every shout out, and every bug report helps me tune [b][i]LEAD - Rally[/i][/b] into better game.
Shift into V0.3 and make the game your own. Whether you're a keyboard knight or a wheel warrior, every turn, every drift, and every finish line is yours to conquer.

Are you ready to take the [i][b]LEAD[/b][/i]?

Stay focused,
Will

notes.title: LEAD - Rally - V0.2.1 - HOTFIX
notes.content:
Hey Rally Family,

I've found a rare bug that could have been playing with your hard-earned unlocks. Some of you might have completed challenges, only to find the garage doors still locked. Not cool, right?

But don't worry - this has been resolved.
Now, when you dominate a challenge, you'll get the shiny cars and glory you've rightfully earned.

Stay sharp,
Will

notes.title: First Weekly Update - LEAD - Rally V0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Drivers![/h1]

It's time for me to announce[i][b] LEAD - Rally[/b][/i]'s first real update, Version 0.2, is now drifting into your gaming rigs. Grab your virtual helmets - things just got a whole lot smoother (and, dare I say, easier?).

[h2]What's Shifting in Gear:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Reworked Aero:[/b] The downforce has been increased by roughly 20%. What does this mean for your gameplay? More stability at breakneck speeds, more grip when you're flirting with the edge, and overall, a wilder ride that still feels tight and right.
[*] [b]Choose Your Challenge:[/b] I've heard you and introduced difficulty levels and driving assists. Whether you're just taking the training wheels off or you're ready to drift with no assists like a pro, there's a setting for you. Newcomer, Seasoned, or Legend - pick your poison!
[*] [b]Tutorial Mode Engaged:[/b] Full tutorial stage has been rolled out to show you the ropes. This is your chance to go from zero to hero at your own pace. Learn the ins and outs without the pressure and get to know the game's mechanics.
[/list]

Your feedback is what makes all this possible. Please, keep the comments, high-fives, and bug squashing reports flowing!

Update now to 0.2 and remember, whether you're grinding gears or gliding smoothly, every drift counts.

Are you ready to take the [i][b]LEAD[/b][/i]?
Wait for the green aaaaaand -  update!

Stay sharp,
Will

notes.title: LEAD - Rally - V0.1.1 - HOTFIXES
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]I can't see any buttons?![/b] - Now the game works with UHD and 21:9 aspect ratio monitors thanks to adjustments to the UI re-sizing logic
[*][b]Where is my Co-Driver?![/b] - Missing audio connections have been fixed for the co-driver call-outs
[*][b]The car is too difficult to control![/b] - Added ESC control logic to the car, which makes it easier to control the car and stop it from spinning. I am planning to add Difficulty settings to the game soon.
[/list]

Thank you everyone, who has decided to try my game, it means an awful lot!

We have been off to a rocky start, but that's why Early Access is great so I can get feedback directly from you guys!

Any further issues or feedback, please let me know in the discussions - the discord server will be set-up soon as well!
